subject: Bifactor-(S-1) model - latent means of g-factor

messages.author: afd065d6db39d327
messages.subject: Bifactor-(S-1) model - latent means of g-factor
parts:
Hi lavaan community,

I'm investigating a bifactor model with a reference domain (bifactor-(S-1) model) and testing measurement invariance across groups. Specifically, I'm evaluating configural, metric, and scalar invariance.

If I achieve partial scalar invariance, is it valid to compare and interpret latent means of the general factor? I used a reference group and set its latent mean of the general factor to zero for identification. Do I also need to constrain the intercepts of the reference domain indicators to be equal across groups? The latent means of the specific factors were fixed to zero, as they are considered residual factors.

Thank you very much in advance,
Simon
